title: Matrix representation of linear transformations and similarity
objectives: Compute the matrix of a linear map relative to ordered bases
Prove that representation is a linear isomorphism that turns composition into product
Derive the change-of-basis and similarity formulas
Use invariants to separate non-similar matrices
prerequisites: Chapters 5, 7 and 8: coordinates, linear maps and their algebra, and determinants.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 16 and 17 were read in full; the second numerical computation completes an example left open there, and the running matrix and exercises are original.
